profile.headline: Software Engineer at CAE Simuflite
profile.summary: Software Engineering professional with experience and specialties in Object-Oriented Design/Programming, Client-Server Architecture/Design/Development on Linux/Unix and Windows platforms, Embedded Software Design/Programming, Full Software Development Life Cycle with Agile and traditional Methodologies, Relational DBMS (including Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MS SQL).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accomplishment: Contributed to software updates for the Tropos visual system, Upset Prevention and Recovery Training (UPRT), Runway Status Lights (RWSL), and Flight Management System (FMS) rehost.
• Implemented full software development of the Runway Status Light (RWSL/LAHSO) functionality.
• Implemented software update/integration of Upset Prevention and Recovery Training (UPRT).
• Implemented full software development of the client/server remote access for the UPRT tablet.
• Involved in SDF and SLD for software development and deployment on CAE full flight simulators.
• Performed the entire visual software update on non-CAE and CAE-built simulators.
• Debugged, modified, and fixed the host/minihost/IOS codes for non-CAE and CAE-built simulators.
• Tuned the Image Generator (IG) and made necessary adjustments for the visual system to operate at the required standards regulated by the FAA, EASA, TC, UK, CAAC, etc.
• Participated in the FMS rehost update.  Installed new CPU and RAM in the AIX Unix host and installed new Arinc 429 PCMIPs and MA546010PCI-Express-Carrier-Board in the rehost PC.  Added new software modules and executable entry points to parent nodes on the simulator host.  Installed and configured OPC/OPS and Navigation Databases on the rehost PC.
• Performed ATM/BTM checks as well as functional/integration testing on the full flight simulators.
• Performed different methods of disk backup and restore on the hosts, control station, rehosts, etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Having worked with Object-Oriented Designing and Programming as well as through every stage of the entire Software Development Life Cycle for the large-scale applications on the distributed systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accomplishment: Completed software project for the Jet Engine Data Acquisition Test System.
• Designed/developed TCP/IP client-server data acquisition applications in C++ to collect jet engine data from the dynamometers (V35/V250) through the compactRIO Embedded Systems.
• Collaborated in a team to integrate/test software and hardware components for production. 
• Installed/configured Windows/Linux OSs on VersaLogic Bengal Single Board computers.
• Backed up and restored Windows and Linux OSs using Paragon Hard Disk Manager software.
• Installed/configured Linux/Windows virtual machines on in-house testbed computer systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accomplishment: Contributed to project management, software design and development.
• Executed the entire software development life cycle (design, coding, debugging, testing).
• Designed and developed the enhanced functionalities and implemented code fixes in the Train Signaling and Message Handling application.  Lead Software Engineer on the BNSF TSS project.
• Designed and developed Qt C++ client-server MVC graphical UIs to support TSMH app.
• Designed and developed interfaces for data insertion/retrieval between TSMH and MySQL.
• Performed different software tests (System/Integration Test, FAT, UT, FT, RT, PT, DVT).
• Packaged software releases using GNU RPMBUILD tools on Jenkins and Linux systems.
• Built/tested software using Jekins (CI), JIRA and managed codes using CVS and Perforce.
• Participated in a team effort to work on the project scheduling, planning and managing.
• Installed, configured, utilized MySQL/PostgreSQL/Oracle database servers on Linux/Windows.
• Utilized database query tools (dbForge Studio and DbVisualizer) to view/modify data and generate reports of train symbols, logged data, and Consist/Speed Restriction information.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Dallas/Fort Worth Area | Security and Investigations
positions.description:
Accomplishment: Contributed greatly to software design/development/testing, completed multiple Security project assignments and provided technical support to Nuclear Power Plants and Airports.
• Developed new software features in C++ for AIM Security software system.  Independently worked on each phase of the full software development life cycle (design, coding, debugging, unit/functional testing).  Effectively worked on new and existing software documentation (requirement/design documents, administration/user manuals, functional test and factory acceptance test documents).  Collaboratively worked with peer software engineers during design review, code review as well as system integrating and testing.
• Developed AIM User Interfaces in Object-Oriented C++ using Model-View-Controller (MVC) Design Pattern to keep the large-scale applications less complex and easy to maintain.
• Developed C++ client-server/multi-threaded applications with TCP/IP socket programming to transfer real-time access control transactions from Linux system to Windows system.
• Developed C++ multi-threaded applications with serial communication RS232 (COMM Port) to receive personnel's badge records from an external system to update in the database server.
• Developed embedded software applications in C++/C for Mercury Security access control system with card readers to operate in stand-alone mode as a real-time embedded system.
• Implemented C++/C code fixes for all back-end and front-end software components.
• Performed manual data transfer from a badging system using MS Access with ODBC.
• Conducted AIM security system administrative training classes on customer sites.
• Installed/configured new operating systems (Windows, Linux) on servers/workstations.
• Installed/configured virtual machines with Linux/Windows-based Operating Systems.
• Installed/configured Oracle Database Server 11g, 10g, 9i on Linux/Windows-based systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accomplishment: Participated in a team effort for software release and support.
• Developed/tested Unix C/C++ applications for automation tests of semiconductor FAB tools.
• Developed/tested Oracle Call Interface/Pro* C applications, Unix shell scripts, Tcl/Tk and Oratcl scripts to perform data insertion and collection for SC FAB system analysis/processing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accomplishment: Completed multiple project assignments on software development for a startup company's wireless network product.
• Developed client-server applications embedded in UDI card to verify and transfer the encoded and decoded data for feature providers on Linux platform.
• Developed various functions for voice features on a POSIX platform.
• Worked on OAM&P functionality to develop customer-facing applications embedded in CMT card for the billing subsystem a pSOS platform.
• Developed ASN.1 messaging and client-server interface applications with TCP/IP socket programming for CALEA (Communications Assistance for Law Enforcement Act) feature on Linux/pSOS platforms.
• Worked on software design specification and functional design specification documentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accomplishment: Worked through the entire SDLC on a brand-new software product of which sole ownership was assigned in order to provide 24 by 7 technical support and maintenance services.
• Developed Internet/Intranet applications using JavaScript, Vignette StoryServer Scripts, Perl, Tcl/Tk, HTML for the interactive front-end interfaces and Java language for the back-end.
• Developed Unix shell scripts and C++/C applications for the back-end use to automatically restart all instances and processes to wake up applications after losing database connections.  Developed stored procedures for use with web-based interface to check for the status of database connection and reset user’s password.
• Developed Pro* C applications with embedded SQL statements for use with Unix shell scripts and Perl to perform daily update transactions and data transfer.
• Performed production support on Web applications and stand-alone business applications.
• Provided technical assistance and testing effort on Internet/Intranet applications and stand-alone business applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Dallas/Fort Worth Area | Flight Simulation & Training Systems
positions.description:
Accomplishment: Worked on software testing and enhancement for the flight simulation product.
• Implemented and enhanced applications (SIVAM project) on Unix for the Surveillance systems.
• Fixed and maintained graphical user interface applications that provided the capability of setting and controlling the flight mission scenarios.
• Performed DR work for F-18 simulation software using FORTRAN and C languages.
• Worked on software file tree retrieval for system test programs using Unix shell scripts, Perl.
• Revised and updated software functional design specification documentation.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Arlington
